name: Running Coach
tagline: Reads your Garmin runs, scores them, and holds the next session until you recover
description: Connect your Garmin data and after every run you get an honest read on what went well, the one fix worth making, and a prescription for the next session. Hard days stay locked until recovery says you are ready, which is where self-coached runners usually break. The coaching is only words; the legs stay yours.
author: IHybben
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
